use_case: Tailgating detection: counts people passing each lobby turnstile lane against badge reads and alerts the security console with a clip
vendor_or_model: Access control and video platform vendor (computer-vision person-detection model)
data_categories: Video of lobby turnstile lanes; turnstile badge events; alert clips (no face templates; no identity inferred)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (advisory alerts); escalates to Safety/CI if alerts drive automatic turnstile or door actions
human_in_the_loop: Console officer reviews the clip and badge record before any action; only a courteous badge check is allowed; no refusal of entry or discipline based on an alert
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)) and the FTC biometric policy statement (May 18 2023); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (video is excluded from biometric data under 501.702); Fla. Stat. 934.03 (keep audio disabled)
status: Approved (pilot at Property A with conditions due 2026-10-31)

use_case: Face verification: compares a live face capture at the turnstile with the enrolled badge photo and denies entry on a mismatch
vendor_or_model: Access control and video platform vendor (face recognition model)
data_categories: Face templates from badge photos and live captures (biometric data)
human_in_the_loop: None proposed by the vendor: the system would deny entry automatically
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 and the FTC biometric policy statement; Fla. Stat. 501.171 (biometric data is personal information: breach notice and reasonable measures)
status: Proposed (rejected by the COO 2026-08-31; vendor instructed not to enable)
